run_habitat_train: run a habitat baselines training experiment using a config YAML file and the train run type
run_habitat_eval: run a habitat baselines evaluation experiment using a config YAML file and the eval run type
build_parser: build an argparse parser with run-type and exp-config arguments for habitat baselines experiments
execute_exp: execute a habitat experiment by loading a trainer from the baseline registry and running train or eval
run_exp: run a habitat experiment given a config file path, run type, and optional CLI override options
